# Janus de Vries - Fullstack Developer Portfolio

> Information and projects by Janus de Vries, full-stack web developer.

This file provides a structured index of the core sections and project case studies available on this portfolio site for LLM inference and agentic discovery.

- https://janusdevries.nl/mywebsites : Web applications and design builds.
- https://janusdevries.nl/odin : The Odin Project learning projects.
- https://janusdevries.nl/trading : Case studies and stories on trading utilities.
- https://janusdevries.nl/unity : Case studies and stories on Unity Projects.
